entries.text: --make that 4 kills.
--this is gonna be your lucky day.
5th platoon, secure air-locks on deck 11. 14th platoon rendezvous with 22nd tactical at bulkhead Charlie 14.
A dozen Covenant superior battle-ships against a single Halcyon-class cruiser.
All you greenhorns who wanted to see Covenant up close--
Alright then. I'm initiating Cole Protocol, Article 2. We're abandoning the Autumn.
Am I right, Marines?
And Cortana...
And if it doesn't, make sure my daughter gets this.
Are you ready?
As for tracking us all the way from Reach, at light-speed my maneuvering options were limited.
Attention, all combat personnel. Please report to your action stations.
Attention, all personnel. We are re-engaging the enemy. External and internal contact imminent.
Aye-aye, sir!
Aye-aye, sir.
But I've isolated approach signatures for multiple CCS-class battle-groups. Make it three capital ships per group ... and in about 90 seconds they'll be all over us.
Captain Keyes?
Captain, the cannon was my last offensive option.
Cortana did her best, but we never really had a chance.
Cortana to Cryo 2, transmitting security code. Bridge out.
Cortana, all I need to know, is did we lose them?
Don't get any funny ideas.
Earth.
Everyone, sir?
Everyone.
Excellent work Cortana. Thank you.
Fireteams: report to defensive positions Alpha through Sierra. Sensors show inbound Covenant boarding craft. Stand by to repel boarders.
Get here first? The Covenant's ships have always been faster.
Good luck, Master Chief.
Good to see you, Master Chief.
He's hot! Blowing the pins in 5.
Heads-up everyone. This is it! We're entering the ring's atmosphere in 5!
Hell if I know. But we're landing on it!
Hmm. Your architecture isn't that much different from the Autumn's.
Hmmm?
I appreciate your concern, Cortana, but it's not up to me. The Protocol is clear: destruction or capture of a shipboard AI is absolutely unacceptable. And that means you're leaving ship.
I got a bad feeling about this, muchacho. Real freakin' bad.
I knew it. The Autumn's accelerating. Keyes is going in manual.
I think we both know the answer to that.
I understand.
I want everyone at their stations.
I've already begun.
If all goes well, we'll rendezvous on the object's surface.
In a manner of speaking.
It must be one of their boarding parties. I'd guess an anti-matter charge.
Let's give our old friends a warm welcome.
Lock in a selection of emergency landing zones, upload them to my neural-lace, then sort yourself for a hard transfer.
Look!
Ma'am! Fire control for the main cannon is off-line!
Men! Keep your eyes downrange, fingers on your triggers and we'll all go home in one piece.

Men, here's where we show those split-chinned, squid-headed sons-a-bitches that they couldn't of picked a worse enemy than the human race! We are going to blow the hell out of those dumb bugs until we don't have anything left to shoot them with, and then we are going to strangle them with their own living guts!

Men, we led those dumb bugs out to the middle of nowhere to keep them from getting their filthy claws on Earth, but we stumbled onto something they're so hot for that they're scrambling over each other to get it. Well, I don't care if it's God's own anti-son-of-a-bitch machine or a giant hula-hoop – we are not going to let'em have it! What we will let 'em have is a belly full'a lead and a pool of their own blood to drown in!
Mmm-hmm. Damn right I am. Now move it out! Double-time!
No thanks to your driving, yes.
Not that you'll listen, but I'd suggest letting my sub-routines handle the final approach.
Now would be a very good time to leave.
Nyah!
OK. Bringing low-level systems online. His vitals look good.
Oh no, oh no!
Once again, it is our job to finish what the fly-boys started. When we meet the enemy, we will rip their skulls from their spines, and toss 'em away laughing.
Our fighters are mopping up the last of their recon picket now. Nothing serious.
Punch it.
Report.
Right. Let's thaw him out.
Sir, yes, sir!
Sleep well?
So where do we stand?
So you did miss me.
Stay cool, Mendoza.
That means you too, Cortana
The Autumn will continue evasive maneuvers until you initiate a landing sequence.
The Autumn--she's been hit!
The object we found. I'm going to try and land the Autumn on it.
They were waiting for us on the far-side of the planet.
Things aren't going well.
Think it's the same ones that hit us at Reach?
This is not a drill. I repeat. This is not a drill.
Until we decelerated. No one could have missed the hole we tore in slipspace
We made a blind jump. How did they fo-
We were running dark, yes?
We'll be fine.
We're disengaged. Going for minimum safe distance!
We're gonna make it, aren't we Sir? I don't wanna die out here!
We're right back in it, huh Sarge?
Well. That's it then. Bring the ship back up to Combat Alert Alpha.
What do you expect, rifleman? You think this little pleasure cruise is going to last forever?
What is that thing, Lieutenant?
Which is where you come in, Chief. Get Cortana off this ship. Keep her safe from the enemy. If they capture her, they'll learn everything: force deployment, weapons research...
While you do what? Go down with the ship?
Whoa .... Sir?
With all due respect, Sir: this war has enough dead heroes.
With those odds I'm content with three--
Yank me.
You heard the lady. Move like you got a purpose!
You sure you wouldn't rather take a seat?
Damn! Airbrake failure! They blew too early!
Echo-419 to Cortana. Foehammer is on station and ready for another pickup.
I'm losing her! Brace for impact!
New traffic on the Covenant battle net! I've found Captain Keyes. He's being held on a Covenant cruiser I disabled before we abandoned the Autumn.
We should move out, Lieutenant, and then we'll need your help on a rescue mission.
We're coming in too fast!
Ahh no need. I'll take this bird out myself.
Captain! Hunters!
Chief, Cortana: I have a new mission for you. We need to beat the Covenant to Halo's control room.
Chief: I want you on point.
Coming here was reckless. You two know better than this...Thanks...
Everybody mount up let's get onboard!
Give me a minute to  interface with the ship's controls...
Hang on!
I see you kept her safe...she's in good hands.
Marines!  Lock and load your weapons let's be ready to move!
Nice one, Sir!

Now I see. I have intercepted a number of message about a Covenant search team, scouting for a "control room". I thought they were looking for the bridge of a cruiser that I damaged during the battle above the ring. But they must be looking for Halo's control room.
Ok sir!

One moment, sir: accessing the Covenant battle net. According to the data in their networks, the ring has some kind of deep religious significance. They call it "Halo." If I'm analyzing this correctly...they believe that "Halo" is some kind of weapon...one with vast, unimaginable power.
Sir!
So, how do we get inside the ship if it's in the air? The Corps issued me a rifle, not wings.
That's bad news. If Halo is a weapon, and the Covenant gain control of it, they'll use it against us and wipe out the entire human race.
That's it, the dropship is loose.
The enemy has captured Captain Keyes and are holding him aboard one of their cruisers, the "Truth and Reconciliation." The ship is currently holding position above the other end of this plateau.
Then it's true.  The Covenant kept saying that "who ever controls Halo controls the fate of the universe".
There's a gravity lift that ferries troops and supplies between the ship and the surface. That's our ticket in.
Time for a little payback.
Touchdown in 10 seconds, people. We're in Covenant territory now.
While the Covenant had us locked up in here I overheard the guards talking about this ring world.
Yes sir!
Affirmative. Foehammer out.
Analyzing... Halo's control center is located there. That structure appears to be some sort of temple, or shrine if I've interpreted this correctly.
But while they're busy trying to figure out how this godforsaken ring works, we're going to remind them just how strong we still are.

Chief. Cortana. Load-up two flights of Pelicans and get to that map room before the Covenant. Everybody else, you're with me. We'll distract them, keep as much heat away from you as we can. Once you have the map, head to the control center, and we'll rendezvous for a frontal assault.
Cortana to Captain Keyes.
Each of you deserves to know what we're up against and what is at stake.

Every single on of you still standing here have demonstrated what can be done with the right weapons and a smart plan of attack. We're the underdogs in a guerilla war, no doubt about it. But we have fallen back far enough. It's time we took the fight to them!

For decades, we've battled an alien enemy we do not understand. Unprovoked, they brought our civilization to its knees and forced us into hiding. And now, chased into the darkness, we have one chance for survival, one chance that carries the hope of our entire species, and has led us here.
Gather 'round, Marines.
Go, go, go!
Halo - that's what the Covenant call this ring, and they believe it's some sort of weapon.
Harvest. New Harmony. Arcadia ... Reach. The Covenant think that the more they take, the weaker we become.
Hold still so I can--oh, I see.
I don't need to tell you how important this mission is, Master Chief. What ever the cost, there's no way we can let the Covenant control Halo.
I hope you're analysis is on the money, Cortana. This Pelican won't turn on a dime...
If Halo is a weapon, then we're going to snatch it out of their blood-stained claws , turn it against them ,and make them pay for every soul we've lost.
Interesting. A shrine is an unlikely place to put such a significant installation.

Keep trying. Let me know when you've reestablished contact and relay to him that the Master Chief and I have determined the location of the Control Center. We'll be heading there as soon as we're topside.
Let's get moving! Foehammer: here are coordinates and a flight plan I've worked up.
Look on the bright side, Foehammer: the last thing the Covenant will expect is an aerial insertion... from underground.
Marines! Let's move!
The Captain has dropped out of contact, Cortana. His ship may be out of range or having equipment problems...
The Covenant believe that what they call the "Silent Cartographer" is somewhere under this island. The Cartographer is a map room that will lead us to Halo's Control Center.
The Covenant did a thorough seismic scan, and my analysis shows that Halo is honeycombed with deep tunnels... that circle the whole ring.
There! That holo-panel should activate the map.
Touchdown! Hit it, Marines!
Uh, Cortana, these coordinates are underground.
We're approaching the LZ.  It's gonna be hot. Get set to come out swinging!
Who's with me?
Before it's too late!
Cortana?
Good luck, Foehammer out.
I don't understand --
Keyes? What are we ---
Let's stay focused. Halo. How do we use it against the Covenant?
Never been better!
No. That terminal. Try there.
Oh?!?
Roger that. We'll be able to find our way to the Control Center from here.
Slow down. You're losing me.
So, what sort of weapon is it?
Something buried? Where?
The Captain! We've got to stop the Captain!
The Covenant found something. Buried in this ring. Something horrible. And now...they're afraid.
The Covenant were right! This ring...it's Forerunner! Give me a second to access...
The weapons cache he's looking for, it's not really--we can't let him get inside!
There's no time! Get out of here! Find Keyes! Stop him!
This is as far as I can go.
This is it. Halo's Control Center.
This ring isn't a cudgel, you barbarian. It's something else...something much more important.
Those Covenant fools! They must have known! There must have been signs!
What are you talking about?
Yes! The Forerunners built this place, what they called a "fortress world" in order to--wait. No, that can't be...
You alright?
You can't imagine the wealth of information--the knowledge! So much! So fast! It's glorious!
--which is weird, right? I mean, look at it.
Above you!
Aw--this is loco!
Behind you!
Boy, you always got a bad feeling about something.
But Sarge, listen!
But--
Captain? Sergeant?  --you hear me?
Chief!  I've lost your signal, where'd you go!?! Chief! Chief!
Come. This way.
Corporal? Do you copy, over?
Covenant. Lot's of 'em...'cept they're all dead.
Don't even think about it, Marine!
Everywhere! I don't--
Gaaah!
Get back here, Marine! That's an order!
Get it out! Get--it--out!
Go! Go! Go!
God damn it, Jenkins! Fire your weapon!
Greetings. I am the Monitor of Installation Zero Four. I am 343 Guilty Spark.
Hey, if the Covenant wanna wipe out this particular part of my history, that's fine by me.
Hold still! Hold still!
I don't have time for your lip, soldier! I gave you an order!
I got a bad feeling about this.
I'll try, Sir. But looks like these Covenant worked pretty hard to lock it down.
Jenkins!
Just do it, Marine.
Keep moving.
LZ looks clear! I'm bringing us down.
Let 'em have it!
Looks like a Covenant patrol. Bad-ass elite units. All KIA.
Mendoza, get your ass back up to second squad's position, and find out what the hell is going on!
Mendoza, move it up!
My function is to prevent it from leaving this Installation, but I require your assistance.
Nah, we just met.
OK, let's move!
Real pretty. Friend of yours?
Right. Let's get this door open.
Sergeant, we're surrounded!
Show me.
Sir!
Someone has released the Flood.
Something scrambled the insides.
Stay close, Jenkins!
Sweet Mother!
The last transmission from the Captain's dropship was from this area. That was over 12 hours ago...
There are too many, Sarge!
There! Mira!
Unh!
Wait here for the Captain and his squad, then get your ass inside!
Watch your mouth, son! This "stuff" is your history. It should remind you grunts what we're fighting to protect!
We got contacts--lot's of 'em! But they're not Covenant---just tearing through us!  --No! No!
What do we have Sergeant?
What is that?
What the?!
What's going on, soldier?
What's that? Plasma scoring?
Whatcha got?
When you locate Captain Keyes, radio in and I'll come pick you up.
Where's that coming from, Mendoza?
Why do we always have listen to this old stuff, Sarge?
Yeah, I dunno. Maybe there was an accident. You know, friendly-fire or something?
Yeah, better it than us!
Yes, sir.
You ask real nice next time you see 'em, Bisenti. I'm sure they'll be happy to oblige.
You'd better have a look at this, Sarge!
I would conjecture that the other species currently on the Installation are responsible for releasing the Flood. They seem most persistent in their attempts to access restricted areas.
If the Flood escapes this Halo, it will of course consume all viable hosts in this galaxy.

Protocol requires that I take possession of the Index for transport. Your organic form renders you vulnerable to infection. The Index must not fall into the hands of the Flood before we reach the control room and activate the Installation.
The Flood is spreading. We must hurry.
We are near the Index Chamber. Follow me.
We must collect the Index before we can activate the Installation.

Why, naturally, the Flood is simply too dangerous to release, and mass sterilization protocols may again need to be enacted. Of course, samples were kept here after the last catastrophic outbreak--for study. It seems that decision may have been an error.
-- but I'm pretty sure I can pull it from your suit without permanently damaging your shields.
...which means that any organism with sufficient mass and cognitive capability is a potential vector.
A construct? In the Core? That is absolutely unacceptable!
And that's exactly what Halo is designed to do: wipe the galaxy clean of all sentient life.
And yet ....
But you already knew that.
Chief, I'm picking up movement...
Cortana!
Do it.
Do what?! I have the Index. You can just float and sputter!
Do you have any idea what that bastard almost made you do?!
Enough!
Get-us-out-of-here!
Hold on--he's a friend.
How...how dare you?! I'll--
Humans, Covenant--whatever! You're all equally edible. The only way to stop the Flood is to starve them to death.
I learned how to tap into the grid when I was in the Control Center. Unfortunately, each jump requires a rather consequential expenditure of energy--
I mean, how couldn't you?
If you are unwilling to help, I will simply find another. Still I must have the Index. Give your construct to me, or I will be forced to take her from you.
Is it true?
Is something wrong?
Last time you asked me: "If it were my choice, would I do it?" Having had considerable time to ponder your query, my answer has not changed: there is no choice. We must activate the ring.
Left out that little detail did he?
Let's find a ride, and get to the Captain.

More or less. Technically this installation's pulse has a maximum effective radius of 25,000 light-years. But once the others follow suit, this galaxy will be quite devoid of life--or at least any life with sufficient bio-mass to sustain the Flood.
Needless to say, I think we should only try this once.
No, that'll take too long.
No...nothing.
Odd. That wasn't supposed to happen.
Oh really?
Oh! I didn't realize. He's your pal is he? Your chum?
On that point all the tests were conclusive.
Save his head. Dispose of the rest.
So be it.
Something tells me I'm not going to like this.
Splendid! Shall we?
That final step is reserved for you, Reclaimer.
That's not going to happen.
The Flood is spreading. If we activate Halo's defenses we can wipe them out.
There's a teleportation grid that runs throughout Halo. That's how the Monitor moves about so quickly.
Twelve. Hours. Twelve hours I've been stuck in here watching you cozy up to that thing while it sharpens the knife to slit our throats!

Unfortunately, my usefulness to this particular endeavor has come to an end. Protocol does not allow units with my classification to perform a task as important as the reunification of the Index with the Core.
We have followed outbreak-containment procedure to the letter....You were with me each step of the way as we managed this  crisis...
We need to go. Right now.
What impertinence! I shall purge you at once.
Why would you hesitate to do what you have already done?
Yes. Activate Halo's defenses, and destroy the Flood. Which is why we brought the Index to the Control Center--
You don't believe me? Ask him!
You have a better idea?
You have no idea how this ring works do you? Why the Forerunners built it? Halo doesn't kill Flood, it kills their food!
You mean this?
You sure that's a good idea?
-- what he'd want us to do.
Chief...
Chief?
How do we free him?
I've got a lock on Captain Keyes' CNI transponder signal! He's alive, and the implants are intact! There's some interference from the cruiser's damaged reactor...
It's done. I have the code. We should go.
It's not him. Not any more. The Captain... he's one of them.
Oh, I see! The coordinate data needs to be--
Right. Sorry.
The Covenant network is absolute chaos. From what I've been able to piece together, their leadership ordered all ships to  abandon Halo when they found the Flood. But they were too late.

The Flood overwhelmed this cruiser, and disabled it. The Covenant are terrified the Flood will repair this ship and use it to escape from Halo. They've sent in a strike team to neutralize the Flood, and repair the ship for immediate departure.
Uhn!
We can't let the Flood get off this ring. You know what he'd expect--
At least I still have control over the comm-channels.
Chief! Sentinels!
Come here you...
Did anyone else make it?
Get yo' ass out of here.
Halo. It's finished.
He must be trying to take the core offline. Even if I could get the countdown restarted...I don't know what to do.
He's in Engineering.
He's in my data-arrays! A local tap!
He's stopped the self-destruct sequence.
Here we go...
How much firepower would you need to crack one of the engine's shields?
I leave home for a few days, and look what happens. This won't take long.
I'm afraid that's out of the question, really.
I'm detecting taps throughout the ship--Sentinels most likely. As for the monitor...
It'll hold.
No. I think we're just getting started.
Not much. A well placed grenade perhaps. But why...
OK, I'm coming with you.
Oh hell.
Oh, how I will enjoy every moment of it's categorization! To think you would destroy this installation as well as this record--I am shocked. Almost too shocked for words.
Oh, shiiii...
Pull up! Pull up!
Ridiculous! That you would imbue a warship's AI with such a wealth of knowledge...Weren't you worried it might be captured, or destroyed?
Scanning...no, just dust and echoes...we're all that's left.
See you in the sequel.
Shut them down. We'll need them later.
There must have been something wrong with the coordinate data.
There. That should give us enough time to make it to a lifeboat and put some distance between ourselves and Halo before the detonation.
This thing is falling apart!
Those were the days.
Transfer me back to your suit...we need to go!
We did what we had to do. For Earth. An entire Covenant armada--obliterated! And the Flood...we had no choice.
We'll make it.
We're cutting it close...
We're not going to make it!
Well, that's my cue.
Where is he?
Why do you continue to fight us, Reclaimer? You cannot win. Give us the construct, and I will endeavor to make your death relatively painless.
You can't imagine how exciting this is! To have a record of all our lost time. Human history, is it? Fascinating!
You did that on purpose, didn't you.
...what they lack in mind, they make up for in muscle.
A trap.
And the Jiralhanae...
Are you no different, Demon?
Are you not impressed with our work here? I would have thought you of all creatures would appreciate such steadfast dedication to... improvement.
Beats me.
Been a while since I gotta take ol' Sophie out for a spin.
Boo.
But our objective is that way.
But under our guidance... my guidance, their rage can be controlled. Reshaped.
Exactly. No way to be sure.
Have you enjoyed your stay so far, Demon? Had you and your companion given word of your arrival, I would have arranged a tour.
Hey Wattles! Didn't think your kind got out that much.
Hold your fire, my children.
I call it many things, Demon. Here you can observe the true beauty of the Covenant. Our collective strength a reflection of each member's devotion.
I think we've seen enough already.
I'm in. Let's move.
If UNSC soldiers are being held captive, we need to find out.
Is that what you call it?
Just couldn't save any for me, could you?
Now, you ready to get to it?
Okay, Mister Monologue.
Sorry to interrupt, but we're on the clock.
Sure am, Chief. What's your read?
That doesn't seem right... What could it be?
That's enough talk
The Sangheili, long our partners since the Writ of Union, the burning edge of the Covenant's blade.
The tenacity of the Unggoy. The cleverness of the Kig-Yar
There's a way.
UNSC battle net telemetry. Just ahead.
Well I'll be damned.
What's a Prophet doing here?
You picking this up, Sergeant Major?
"Sit it out" my armor-plated ass. Lieutenant, I can assure you there will be no sitting.
Affirmative. Exit should be this way
Chief and I will secure the bridge. We need your crew to head straight to the nearest hangar bay and secure our ride outta here.
Chief, let's get to the bridge
From the Ninety-Second Shock Troops Battalion?
I'm Lieutenant Williams, Tiger Company.
Lieutenant, we're about to head straight into the middle of the hive to get that honey we came for. The Chief and I will handle that side of things.
No, Sergeant Major, I'm not. It takes more than fancy armor and a good PR campaign to impress me.
Now that's more like it. Give'em hell, Sergeant Major. We'll keep the engine running.
One and the same. Honored you've heard of us, Sergeant Major. We certainly know who you are.
Out of the frying pan and into, well, whatever the hell this place is cookin' with.
Robins! Take the team and give me a perimeter check.
So. What's the plan, Chief?
Sounds good. Williams, we'll get you out of this foxhole, but we've still got a stop to make before we're done.
Thanks Sergeant Major, we owe you one. Didn't think we'd ever see any of our own again.

That said, you do have our thanks. It's been... rough out here to say the least. If it's all the same to you, I'd like to fast-forward the pleasantries and skip to the part where we get the hell off this ship.
That works for us. The more losses we can hand these bastards the better.
The honor's mine, LT. Glad we could help.
Then it looks like we're on the right track. Let's move out, I've got your back, Chief.
UNSC signal is stronger here.
We get the data and exfiltrate.
We're combat ready. We're not about to sit this out.
You don't seem as impressed as the rest of your crew.
-but what fun is easy?
Acknowledged. Welcome aboard.
And I'll be damned if I letta Spartan steal the glory on this one.
And he doesn't need to. You guys get off this ship and get the nav data to the UNSC. We'll drop the shields.
Chief, I've gotta do this. It would haunt me every day to know we let this nightmare factory survive.
Chief, the LT's right, we need to blow this entire ship to molecules. We can't let them finish cooking up what's in these labs.
Copy that. Keep your weapons hot, we'll be in touch.
Copy. On our way.
Damn right.
Did you take out the Prophet?
Do you think there might be other Covenant ships like this out there?
Doc when you're as old as I am, they're all still kids.
Genius often is.
Great idea, but it will only drop the shields for a minute or two at most.
Hard to say. The Prophet seemed to be working alone.
I am glad that you made it back in one piece. And John?
If you can find a way to drop their shield strength--even for a few moments--we should be able to take the shot.
It looks like you just might have found the heart of the Covenant after all.
It's been a one-way trip from the beginning for us, Chief. Least now we get to go out on our own terms.
Let's move out, Marines.
Libra Actual, this is Libra Two. I'm breaking radio silence to request immediate assistance. We are green for exfil. Requesting a fire mission against our current location.
Libra Two, this is Libra Actual. We are ready for rendezvous.
Ma'am.
Missions change, Chief. Always do. And now we're giving these Marines a chance to punch back.
Negative, Lieutenant, that's a one-way trip.
Negative.
Nice work.
Oh, One-One-Seven? He's a good kid.
Pleasure serving with you, Lieutenant.
Sierra-117 to Lieutenant Williams. Status report.
So. Take out the generators
So...
Sorry, I was gettin' real tired of hearing him talk.
Spartan's aren't the only badasses in the UNSC.
Tactical indicates our ship doesn't have the firepower to penetrate the target's energy shields.
Thanks.
That wasn't the mission.
That's all the time they need to take the shot.
That's our cue, Chief. Time to go.
The Covenant aren't making it easy-
There is so much you do not understand about the Great Journey, humans. Why it cannot be stopped. Your kind is a mere footnote in the story of this galaxy.
They are not children anymore, Sergeant Major.
This is Libra Two, we're ready for pickup.
We need to destroy the ship.
We've also got a staff manifest to submit for posthumous commendations.
Whatever the Covenants working on here needs to be stopped before it can go any further.
When I relay what I have learned to the hierarchs, there will be nothing that can stop us from---
Yeah, but you can't be here when the fireworks start.
You should be pleased to know this little excursion was well worth the effort.
Being the one to make the sacrifice is easy.
Being the ones left behind is hard.
Causes and comrades, friends and family.
From the outside it looks like this monumental choice.
I think I'm leaving humanity in good hands.
It's a big deal to everyone... everyone except the person doin' the sacrificing.
It's on you now. All of you.
Like you're placing weights on the scales of the universe.
Sometimes, a choice comes along with a direction so crystal clear that you don't even blink.
The reality is different though.
Time for you to prove me right.
What matters in the moment is doing everything you can for the things you love most.
Williams out.
You act. Let history figure out the rest.
You don't agonize, you don't hem and haw.
You know it's a funny thing, sacrifice.
Affirmative. I just have to reset the computer and I'm out of here.
Alert! Alpha and Charlie teams report heavy fighting on port decks 5 through 9. Foxtrot Team: move to starboard decks 8 and 10 and stand by.
All combat personnel: fall back to tertiary defensive positions.
All hands, this is the Captain. Prepare to abandon ship. Combat Teams: Repel boarders until Ops personnel are away.
All hands: this is your Captain. Any remaining personnel to the lifeboats immediately. Abandon ship! I repeat: ABANDON SHIP.
All remaining combat teams, pull out and abandon ship.
All remaining crew and ops personnel: hit the lifeboats! Fall back to evac stations.
All right...shields read as fully charged.
Aye aye sir.
Behind us! They're right behind us!
